T_Body_BC_VT was resized from 8192 to 2048 px; every other texture was already at or below 2048 px.
SurvivalRpg needs no new plugin: MetaHumanCharacter and MetaHumanCoreTech have been enabled since the GASP import and bring RigLogic and HairStrands.
